_meta.notes: SYNTHETIC. The other end of the ignition budget. A hypergolic pressure-fed service engine relights without limit, which RealFuels stores as the sentinel -1 rather than as a large count, and the section says UNLIMITED rather than showing the raw number (a '-1 LEFT' readout would be the exact failure the derived flags exist to prevent). It is also NOT SUBJECT to ullage: hypergolics settle themselves, so there is no stability to report and the row says so. A settled reading here would be a claim the Uplink cannot support, and it would look identical to a good one.

_scene.caption: A hypergolic service engine: relights without limit and is not subject to ullage, so neither reading is a number
